decision_inherited.primary_economic_scale: no_tax_roi (BJ Single Match 0.65 factor included; per-ticket tax not deducted)
decision_inherited.rule: Primary ranking and decision use common-support no-tax ROI deltas. Numeric samplers require positive ALL deltas in all three frozen seeds and positive deltas in every leave-one-year-out omission and seed. Deterministic top-mass is evaluated separately without a numeric-seed requirement. YEAR and FOLD rows are diagnostics, not unanimity vetoes. A stable lift whose candidate no-tax ROI is positive in every frozen seed is a positive candidate requiring strict independent EV; tax-adjusted metrics remain secondary execution sensitivity.
